description: CLI filesystem and transport adapters. Shared domain contracts and Host authority own product mutations.

modules.api.ts: Discovered/configured Host HTTP transport preserving all HeadersInit forms and optional hosted authentication.
modules.document-worktree.ts: Native Document file projection and internal observed.json evidence. Each file retains its own original baseline; apply never refreshes it with a get. No sidecar locks, force or manifest fallback.
modules.legacy-metadata-body.ts: Read-only compatibility for historical manifest and Timeline metadata bodies in the existing body store.
modules.transcript-grid.ts: Stable word-grid content hashing for legacy Timeline transcript readers; no metadata writer.
modules.worktree-observations.ts: Project-scoped atomic internal observation ledger shared by CLI entities.
